results.evidence: _qualified counts distinct lead_ids from counted stage_change activities in the period whose payload 'to' is buyer_need_confirmed. The counted set excludes voided rows, correction reverts and test leads. Dates are filtered by period.contains. The tests cover each AC clause and all 18 tests in tests/test_report_conversations.py pass. Two counted moves on one lead give 1 (test_two_moves_on_one_lead_count_once, which first asserts two such moves exist). A voided move gives 0, and a revert into buyer_need_confirmed gives 0 (events.is_revert is asserted). A test lead's move gives 0, and moves dated before the period give 0. I did not run my own mutation probe, and I did not separately read events.counted_activities, which is where the voided, revert and test-lead exclusions live. The tests exercise it through the CLI.

build_report counts each of the five outcome kinds with _counted_in_period, which excludes voided rows. render_report prints them under 'Conversations and KPI'. test_outcome_counts_skip_voided creates one counted and one voided event of each kind plus an out-of-period won, and asserts each label prints '1'. test_empty_database_prints_zero_outcomes_and_hours asserts each prints '0' on an empty DB. All 18 tests in tests/test_report_conversations.py pass.

Otherwise it returns (qualified+partner)/founder_hours rounded to 2 places. test_kpi_two_decimals runs the full report command with 1 qualified, 1 partner and 3 founder hours and gets 0.67. test_kpi_na_with_no_founder_hours gets n/a. All 18 tests in tests/test_report_conversations.py passed. I did not run the report command by hand.
